data.text/markdown:
Workforce — Summary for Leadership

All subthemes under Workforce declined between 2022 and 2024. The steepest drop was in Empowerment (-3.5 points), and the lowest-scoring subtheme in 2024 is Job fit and development (60.7 / 100).

Largest declines (2022 to 2024)

  • Empowerment: -3.5 points (2022 to 2024)
  • Job fit and development: -5.0 points (2022 to 2024)
  • Work-life balance and workload: -3.0 points (2022 to 2024)

What this means

Scores represent the percentage of respondents giving a positive or neutral response, expressed on a 0-100 scale. A decline of 3.5 points in a single survey cycle — with ~186,000 respondents — is both statistically significant and operationally meaningful.
Note: Statistical significance is expected at this sample size. Use the magnitude of change, not the p-value, as the primary indicator of policy relevance.
